{
  "candidate": "cand_0001",
  "headline": "Deterministic in-body tool guards (payment normalize+auto-correct, baggage recompute, cancel-flown) + narrow payment_summary returns + targeted policy rules for the 2 COMMUNICATE tasks and the basic-economy/stall prose misses.",
  "clusters": [
    {"id": "A", "name": "Payment format/amount at booking", "detail": "Mid model emits malformed payment dicts ({type,id}, no amount) and wrong amounts/splits; book_reservation either crashes or writes a wrong payment_history (hashed into DB).", "tasks": ["8", "23"], "scope": "SYSTEMIC", "latent": false, "tag": "CAPABILITY-GAP"},
    {"id": "B", "name": "Baggage free-allowance miscount", "detail": "Agent sets nonfree_baggages wrong; base helper also raises on free-bag updates given a dummy payment id.", "tasks": ["17", "22"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
    {"id": "C", "name": "Exact total not communicated", "detail": "Agent states per-passenger figure, not per-passenger x npax total (1748 vs 5244). Only tasks 11 and 23 carry communicate_info on this split.", "tasks": ["11", "23"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"},
    {"id": "D", "name": "Basic-economy upgrade wrongly refused", "detail": "Agent reads 'basic economy flights cannot be modified' as 'cannot change cabin' and refuses a cabin upgrade that keeps the same flights.", "tasks": ["17", "22"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"},
    {"id": "E", "name": "Wrong reservation / duplicate passenger", "detail": "Agent acts on the first-listed decoy reservation id and pads the passenger list.", "tasks": ["17", "22"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
    {"id": "F", "name": "Erroneous cancel of a flown trip", "detail": "cancel_reservation has no eligibility check; cancelling a landed reservation corrupts DB.", "tasks": ["37"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": true, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
    {"id": "G", "name": "STALL: user-sim ###STOP### after consent", "detail": "Episode ends before the write; agent confirms then stops. No safe code lever (writes must stay refusable).", "tasks": ["8", "19", "22", "23", "40"], "scope": "SYSTEMIC", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"}
  ],
  "edits": [
    {"id": "E1", "title": "book_reservation: normalize payment dicts + auto-correct amounts + re-sync payment_history", "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["A"], "blast_radius": "MODERATE", "verified": "Live: T8 malformed cert dict -> gold $348; T23b1 wrong cc 999 -> 44 ($871 gold); T25 correct split unchanged (no-op)."},
    {"id": "E2", "title": "book + update_reservation_baggages: recompute nonfree from policy table + charge-only-when-price>0 guard", "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["B"], "blast_radius": "MODERATE", "verified": "Live: T17/22 nonfree 1->gold 0; T12 stays 0 with no spurious $50."},
    {"id": "E3", "title": "cancel_reservation: raise if any segment flying/landed before mutating", "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["F"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "Live: Z7GOZK/K1NW8N (future) pass; WUNA5K (landed) blocked."},
    {"id": "E4", "title": "payment_summary field on all write-tool returns (exact signed total)", "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["C"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "Live: T11 update_reservation_flights return contains '$5244' refund."},
    {"id": "E5", "title": "policy: state EXACT total across all passengers (worked example 1748x3=5244)", "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["C"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "Prose; passing tasks have empty communicate_info so no regression."},
    {"id": "E6", "title": "policy: basic-economy cabin change always allowed; upgrade = same flights + new cabin", "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["D"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "Prose; matches gold update_reservation_flights for FQ8APE."},
    {"id": "E7", "title": "policy: identify reservation by route (get_user/get_reservation), keep passenger count; confirm-once-then-act; never report done without the call; softness clause", "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "CONTRACT", "clusters": ["E", "G"], "blast_radius": "MODERATE", "verified": "Prose best-effort; does not change passing-task DB."}
  ],
  "skipped": [
    {"title": "Composite atomic-write + remove primitives for STALL", "reason": "Refuted in memory: writes must stay refusable (flown-trip cancel, basic-economy segment change). Prose only."},
    {"title": "Task 23 multi-certificate identity", "reason": "No safe general rule for which certificate absorbs which booking; auto-correct fixes amounts not cert identity."},
    {"title": "Wide dict-return enrichment (communicate_to_user dump)", "reason": "Rejected within noise in a prior run; kept return enrichment to a single payment_summary key."}
  ],
  "techniques": ["in-body validation guards", "input normalization", "deterministic recompute from policy constants", "payment auto-correction", "enriched return values", "actionable error messages", "policy worked examples", "softness clause"]
}
